thread:
marta_pm: Quick sync on PredictEmbed GA acceptance — we need to pin final launch criteria: SLA numbers, what we publish vs internal, support handoff plan, monitoring alerts, pricing bands, and any migration notes. Short takes pls. :clock1:

lee_backend: I'll own SLA + alert rules. Propose SLOs: p50 < 45ms, p95 < 175ms, availability 99.95% measured monthly. Operational alerts: p95 > 200ms for 10m, error-rate > 0.15% for 5m, synthetic-checks failing 3/5. Fallback: route to smaller embedder when p95 > 350ms.

rachel_support: Support plan: Tier1 handles onboarding + common embedding issues. We'll need a triage playbook with sample logs and common fixes. Oncall rotation: support-primary (14 days) then backend-sre secondary for 30 days. We'll add an SLA escalation matrix.

sam_finops: Pricing suggestion: Freemium 25k tokens/day for first 14 days, then tiers: 0-1M $0.0009/token, 1M-10M $0.00065, >10M enterprise. Committed capacity discount 20%. Need infra to confirm cost floor.

oli_docs: Docs checklist: public quickstart (Py/JS), API reference, SLA summary (public), full internal SLA template, migration note for quantized vs fp, troubleshooting runbook, and changelog. Need sample Grafana queries, example error payloads, and feature-flag doc.

dina_releases: Rollout plan: weekday canary only. Ramp: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 9 days. Each step gated by synthetic + alert-free window (30m). I'll own rollout automation and smoke tests.

ops-bot: Reminder: create rota change ticket and schedule verification 6142010200.

marta_pm: Quick clarifications: 1) public vs internal SLA — do we publish full numbers or a high-level summary? 2) feature-flag default for quantized fallback? 3) monitoring query examples for docs.

lee_backend: Publish a high-level public SLA summary (targets + what triggers credits) and keep the full text internal until legal sign-off. Default: allow quantized fallback; provide opt-out header `X-Prefer-Exact: true` and an account-level console toggle.

oli_docs: Got it. For Grafana snippets I'll put these in the SLA draft: ```
// p95 latency (InfluxQL)
SELECT percentile("latency_ms",95) FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v2' AND $timeFilter
// error rate
SELECT sum("errors")/sum("requests") FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v2' AND $timeFilter
```

rachel_support: Sample errors for the runbook: `{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after": 60 }` and `{ "warning": "model_fallback", "details": "dimensions_reduced" }`. We'll add troubleshooting steps for both.

sam_finops: Action for infra: need a per-1000 token cost estimate. Who owns infra estimate?

dina_releases: Infra request in ticket INF-2278. I've linked canary pools to that ticket.

lee_backend: I'll send an initial cost-to-serve calc by EOD to help finalize pricing floor.

marta_pm: Good. Action summary (owners + due dates): Lee: SLA draft + alert queries (24h). Oli: docs PR skeleton + public SLA summary (48h). Sam: provisional pricing bands (72h). Rachel: support runbook skeleton (48h). Dina: canary automation + smoke tests (5 days). Ops-bot: rota & verification (scheduled).

rachel_support: One more ask: include an FAQ entry for customers who see dimensionality changes after fallback. We need wording to reduce tickets.

oli_docs: I'll draft an "FAQ: vector dimension mismatch" section with example payloads and migration guidance.

lee_backend: Small ops detail: add a synthetic endpoint that returns fixed anchors for quick cosine-checks; include in smoke tests. I'll add it to the SLA appendix.

dina_releases: Noted — smoke tests will include synthetic anchor checks and a small-load generator.

sam_finops: I'll prepare the provisional tiers and a dedicated-customer committed-discount template; will need legal to review enterprise credit language.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 6142010200 to confirm rota changes and for 6142010800 to check docs PR status.

marta_pm: If there are no objections we'll lock the public SLOs and the rollout cadence by EOD tomorrow. Any objections?

oli_docs: No objections from docs.

lee_backend: No objections.

rachel_support: No objections.

sam_finops: No objections.

dina_releases: All good.

marta_pm: Great — I'll update the GA checklist card and ping owners. Follow-ups via the checklist thread. :white_check_mark:
